b6174611f2.q: How can AI increase business value in an exit strategy according to Green & Co?
b6174611f2.a: AI should increase profitability and therefore increase the value people get from exiting their business. If they embrace AI, they can actually grow their business, create capacity, increase profits with more work, and get a better value for the business when they come to sell.
b6174611f2.e: #16 - How AI Could Increase the Value of Your Business
b6174611f2.rq: If you embrace these things and do it early, you could be the leader in your industry and therefore increase the potential value of business for exit.

c4d01d57c7.q: Which industries will AI have the biggest impact on for business operations?
c4d01d57c7.a: Service industries will see AI as a big thing they need to embrace, looking at what processes they can automate and how they can make things run more efficiently. Other industries like care might not have such an impact since you need that person to go in and care for that person and cannot automate that. Manufacturing has had automated processes for a long time and still employs people.

7a2df76c65.q: What are the key steps a business should take to embrace AI for exit planning?
7a2df76c65.a: Do a strengths, weaknesses, opportunity, threats review as a good start. Review your processes to look at repetitive parts and which parts you should concentrate on automating first. Have some AI champions in your business who have time to embrace it and get training. Have a discussion with your accountant about what the processes could change and what that means for capacity and staff levels.

6b3cb6ad6d.q: Can competitors using AI create a competitive risk for businesses that do not adopt it?
6b3cb6ad6d.a: If you don't embrace AI and other people do, your competitors are going to get ahead of you. They're going to be able to run systems that are cheaper and therefore undercut you and still make better profits. If you embrace these things and do it early, you could be the leader in your industry with scope to grow, increase profitability, and increase the potential value of business for exit.
